verdict.rationale: Interview self-scheduling is a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but nothing in the evidence pack covers candidate self-scheduling, booking links, calendar availability sync, or timezone handling. The pack only covers job posting, sourcing, careers pages, API endpoints, webhooks and the MCP server.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
